items.stem: Before committing a code suggestion from Amazon Q Developer, a developer should:

options.text: Review and test it to confirm it is correct and appropriate
options.rationale: Correct: AI suggestions must be reviewed and tested before use.

options.text: Commit it immediately because the AI produced it
options.rationale: AI output can be wrong; review is required.

options.text: Disable version control to avoid conflicts
options.rationale: Disabling version control is unsafe and unrelated.

options.text: Delete all tests to speed up the commit
options.rationale: Removing tests increases risk, not safety.

items.explanation: Correct: Review and test it to confirm it is correct and appropriate.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are appropriate uses of Amazon Q Developer? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Explaining unfamiliar code and suggesting implementations
options.rationale: Correct: Q explains code and offers suggestions to adapt.

options.text: Scanning code for potential security issues
options.rationale: Correct: Q Developer can scan code and suggest remediations.

options.text: Guaranteeing code is 100% secure with no further review
options.rationale: A scan reduces risk but does not guarantee security.

options.text: Accessing resources outside the user's granted permissions
options.rationale: Q operates within the user's permissions, not beyond them.

items.explanation: Correct: Explaining unfamiliar code and suggesting implementations, Scanning code for potential security issues.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Where can Amazon Q Developer assist a developer directly while writing code?

options.text: Inline in the IDE with suggestions and chat
options.rationale: Correct: Q provides inline suggestions and chat within the IDE.

options.text: Only by mailing a report once a month
options.rationale: Q works interactively, not via monthly mail.
Q is an interactive assistant, not printed docs.

items.explanation: Correct: Inline in the IDE with suggestions and chat.
